yuki: Starting a thread for Vela-v1 q5k bringup oddities observed in the last locale run. Different symptoms than prior threads: 1) Furigana (ruby) inline markers being separated from base kanji, 2) ZWJ/emoji ligature breakage next to han characters, 3) mixed fullwidth/halfwidth quotes in vertical-mode samples, and 4) a batch-only parity glitch where leading honorific particles repeat when kvcache+batches>1.

ram: Can you paste a tiny repro + flags?

yuki: Sure. Tokenizer=tokv2, locale_heuristics=on, quant=q5_k (per-channel), kvcache=true, batch=4, max_seq=1024, detok_order=default. Minimal samples below.

yuki: ```
# JA furigana inline (user-pass-through text)
\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e\u6587\u5b57\u6709\u8a2a\u304f\u3088\u3046\u306b\u3001\u30ab\u30bf\u30ab\u30ca\u3092\u63cf\u304f\u300c\u304b\u306a\u300d\u30eb\u30eb
# model call
POST /v1/generate {"model":"vela-v1","prompt":"<JA> \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e... \u300c\u304b\u306a\u300d\u30eb\u30eb","quant":"q5_k"}
```

anya: q5k detok output (sanitized):
"\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \u6587\u5b57 \u6709 \u8a2a \u304f \u3088 \u3046 \u306b \u3001 \u30ab\u30bf \u30ab \u30ca \u3092 \u63cf\u304f \u300c \u304b \u306a \u300d \u30eb\u30eb"

mei: fp16 baseline: "\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e\u6587\u5b57\u6709\u8a2a\u304f\u3088\u3046\u306b\u3001\u30ab\u30bf\u30ab\u30ca\u3092\u63cf\u304f\u300c\u304b\u306a\u300d\u30eb\u30eb" (no spaces around the ruby markers).

ram: We also saw emoji/ZWJ issues; sample:
input: "\u4eca\u65e5\u306f\u3001\u30d1\u30fc\u30c6\u30a3: \ud83d\udc69\u200d\ud83c\udf73" (woman cook emoji using ZWJ)
q5k detok -> emoji displayed separated or replaced by base emoji + visible ZWJ-like placeholder. fp16 ok.

anya: Vertical-layout repro (subtitle style) shows quotes flipping to fullwidth double-prime vs angular quotes in-between lines after detok. Example: input with vertical marker results in mixing of U+201D and U+300D in q5k output.

mei: Also a repeating particle case when kvcache + batch>1: log shows `repeat_detected sample=vela-vert-007 step=22 token=1456 equals earlier token`. Only in q5k with batches.

ops-bot: Canary job vela-staging-21 completed: 4/118 locale checks failed. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/vela-v1/q5k/4376543210/artifacts.tar.gz

ram: Quick diagnostics we ran: token-id parity check shows ids identical up to 10-15 tokens then divergence; pre-detok mapping unchanged. Deterministic replay with fixed seed: fp16 deterministic, q5k shows token jitter near punctuation/marker boundaries.

yuki: Hypotheses: (1) quant centroid noise changing likelihood for small marker tokens (ZWJ, ruby markers), (2) detok normalization ordering interacting with locale heuristics so that small gaps are introduced, (3) kernels that optimize attention for q5k accidentally change neighbor token scoring near low-frequency markers.

ram: Plan: run (A) kernel parity (fp16 kernels on quantized path) to test if execution path is reordering or otherwise changing outputs (ETA 4h), (B) q5k-shared centroids to see if shared table stabilizes rare token emissions (ETA 6h), (C) detok-order experiment (run normalization+bidi before detokenization) (ETA today), (D) collect kvcache traces paired with batch metadata for repeat cases (ETA EOD).

anya: Metric impact from nightly micro-bench (1k JA subtitle-like samples / 500 KO / 400 AR vertical cases):
- JA subtitle chrF: 0.612 -> 0.575 (fp16 -> q5k)
- KO BLEU: 24.5 -> 21.7
- AR quote-preserve F1: 0.995 -> 0.946
- Prefix-repeat incidence: 0/1000 (fp16) -> 9/1000 (q5k, batch>1)

mei: I'll run a small human QA pass focusing on ruby/emoji cases to estimate visible regressions. If >3% visible, block q5k default.

ram: Kicking off parity jobs now (parity-4376, q5k-shared-4377). Uploading token diffs and sample ids to s3 and will paste links here.

yuki: Thanks. Small helper for classifying characters near divergences:```python
import unicodedata
def char_info(s):
    return [(c, hex(ord(c)), unicodedata.name(c, 'UNKNOWN'), unicodedata.bidirectional(c)) for c in s[:80]]
```
